name: modal
title: Modal
description: Native dialog: centered card on desktop, bottom sheet on small screens, scrim via token.
docs: Built on the native `<dialog>`: `showModal()` provides the focus trap, Esc to close, and the top layer; `::backdrop` reads `--uifa-scrim`. Confirm actions use `data-uifa-variant="danger"` for destructive flows. Below 480px the card docks to a bottom sheet.
